name: GutenWise – Premium Blocks for Block Editor (Amazon Review, Pricing Table, Accordion & More)
author: gutenwise

sections.description:
Supercharge your Block Editor experience with GutenWise, a powerful suite of advanced blocks designed for content creators, affiliate marketers, and business owners. Build stunning, high-converting pages faster without writing a single line of code.

GutenWise provides a curated collection of premium blocks that look beautiful out of the box and are fully customizable to match your brand. Whether you are building an Amazon affiliate site, a service landing page, or a professional blog, GutenWise has the tools you need.

🚀 Key Features:

  • Branded Block Category: All blocks are neatly organized under a dedicated “GutenWise” category in the editor.
  • Smart Block Manager: Enable or disable individual blocks to keep your editor clean and fast.
  • Premium Admin Dashboard: Monitor system status and access resources directly from your WordPress admin.
  • Fully Responsive: Every block is designed to look perfect on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Optimized for performance with minimal asset loading.

💎 Featured Blocks:

  • Affilify – Amazon Product Review: High-converting review templates with 5 premium layouts, features integration, and sleek call-to-action buttons.
  • Pros and Cons: Professional comparison lists to highlight what matters most to your audience.
  • Wise Accordion: Smooth, interactive accordions for FAQs or structured content. Fully customizable colors and styles.
  • Price Table: Premium price comparison table for pricing plans or data comparison. Features gradient accents and multiple style templates.
  • Coupon Code: Beautiful coupon code block for affiliate marketing with reveal functionality.
  • Countdown: Beautiful countdown timer for your posts and pages to create urgency.
  • News Ticker: Horizontal scrolling news ticker for announcement or breaking news.
  • Dual Button: Create side-by-side buttons with a customizable separator for clean CTA.
  • Post Grid: Display your recent posts in a beautiful grid layout with advanced filtering.
  • Wise Team: Display your team members with multiple professional styles and social links.

👉 Official Free Demo Link: GutenWise Official Demo

Short Description

Supercharge your content with premium blocks for the editor. Includes Amazon Reviews, Pricing Tables, Accordions, and a Smart Block Manager.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the gutenwise folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Access the GutenWise menu in your sidebar to manage blocks and view the dashboard.
  4. Start adding premium blocks to your pages and posts using the native editor.
sections.faq:
Q. Who should use GutenWise?

A. GutenWise is perfect for bloggers, affiliate marketers (especially Amazon affiliates), and web designers who want to create professional layouts using the native WordPress editor without the bloat of heavy page builders.

Q. Is GutenWise compatible with every theme?

A. Yes! GutenWise blocks are designed to work seamlessly with any well-coded WordPress theme that supports the block editor.

Q. Can I disable blocks I don’t use?

A. Absolutely. Our Smart Block Manager allows you to toggle any block on or off, ensuring that only the assets you need are loaded.
